_comment: Pinned database server packages, one per engine, system (os: std::env::consts::OS) and processor (arch). Change version, url, sha256 and size together (space_bytes: the extracted package plus a new server's data), after confirming the SHA-256 against the independent source in provenance. scripts/verify-database-packages.ps1 checks these pins in CI. skip: top folders not extracted (tests, headers).

packages.provenance: EDB publishes no hash list; SHA-256 equal to ScoopInstaller/Main bucket/postgresql.json at commit 253eb4e8e76f7f4f33118aa16de089db6010900b
